notes.title: New Gameplay Trailer & DEMO Update!!
notes.content:
Dear Nature friends,  

We’ve got something special to share with you today — a brand new trailer for Unpetrified! This trailer reveals even more of the enchanting world you’ll get to explore, along with some of the adorable animals that will accompany you on your journey. We’re so excited to finally show you more of the magic that’s waiting inside the game.  

[previewyoutube="Cex_5-I6i7o;full"][/previewyoutube]

But that’s not all — we’ve also released a fresh update to our demo on Steam! If you haven’t tried it yet, or if you’d like to return for another stroll through our cozy and peaceful world, this is the perfect time. With the update, you can explore both the Cave of Awakening and the lush, colorful Verdant Forest. 

Below you can find some of the changes included in this update. Save games from previous playthroughs of the demo aren't compatible with the new version, so unfortunately you will need to start a fresh run.

We just want to say that your support means the world to us — whether it’s liking, sharing, commenting on the trailer, posting the fox emoji, or simply spreading the word about the demo. Every bit helps us bring Unpetrified to more players who love cozy adventures as much as you do.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42439321/c661319abbe33f8be61e52a70e86ce797a7adfc8.png[/img]

Meeting so many of you at Gamescom was an absolute pleasure as well. Thank you for continuing this journey with us — we can’t wait to hear what you think of the new trailer and the updated demo! 💛🦊  

— Dreamhunt Studio

notes.title: Announcing Our Release Date!
notes.content:
[p]Dear Nature friends,   

We are beyond excited to finally share this with you – we have a release date! "Unpetrified: Echoes of Nature" will officially launch [b]November 11th, 2025[/b] on Steam. 

So mark your calendars – in just a few months, you’ll be able to set out on your journey with our curious Golem and his Fox companion. [url="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=MZNhcKiOYyM"]Here[/url] you’ll find a shortened version of the official gameplay trailer, just for you, before anyone else in the world can see it.

Thank you, as always, for your support, patience, and enthusiasm – you have brought "Unpetrified: Echoes of Nature" to life with us, and we can’t wait for you to experience the adventure this November!    

— Dreamhunt Studio

notes.title: Demo Update!
notes.content:
Dear Nature friends,

Today we've released the first patch for the Unpetrified demo. We've been working hard on improving performance, lighting, VFX and reworking the save system.

Unfortunately, this does mean saves from previous play sessions aren't compatible with the current version of the game. 

You can find the full patch notes below:

[h2]Patch Notes[/h2]
[list][*] Fixed an issue where some plants and animals could display a pink texture
[*] Reduced asset pop-ins in the Cave of Awakening
[*] Fixed an issue where Monuments would not properly save the game progress
[*] Fixed an issue where the Region Map could not be completed for the Cave of Awakening
[*] Improved player collision boundaries for all levels
[*] Minor UI improvements
[*] Minor endscreen adjustments
[*] Added new puzzle introduction cutscene for the first puzzle in Cave of Awakening
[*] Added visual feedback for when the player has no energy
[*] Improved lighting in all levels
[*] Fixed an issue where an incorrect amount of bunnies was displayed during cutscenes
[*] Fixed an issue where music didn't play when skipping the Rock Ball cutscene
[*] Improved game stability[/list]
It has been amazing to read all your feedback. The team is hard at work on finishing the final version of the game, so your input is incredibly valuable!

We can't wait to hear what you think of these changes! 

— Dreamhunt Studio

notes.title: Rolling through the world
notes.content:
Dear adventurers,

Today, we want to share a little bit about our Rock Ball mechanic, which replaces the 'sprinting' you might see in other games. Instead of running through the levels, the Golem turns into a literal Rock Ball. We've been working hard to make this transition feel as seamless as possible. 😊

Rolling around in Rock Ball form isn't just a fun way to get from point A to B, though. The animals in the world will definitely notice! Some of them might run off and act scared, as you're speeding towards them. More curious creatures might actually start rolling alongside you. 

[img]https://shared.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/store_item_assets/steam/apps/1989720/extras/GIF_Golem.gif?t=1744725941[/img]

The same thing applies to the environment. Rolling through a dandelion field spreads flower seeds everywhere. Certain rockpiles and trees can also be knocked over to progress through the level. It adds a different layer of interaction to the world.

Another important part of traveling in Rock Ball form is momentum. Rolling down a big hill or slope ensures that you can reach higher speeds and easily cover great distances. We love the parts of the game that take advantage of this mechanic! 

You'll be able to try the Rock Ball yourself in the demo that will be releasing later this month. 
We can't wait to hear what you think! 👀

— Dreamhunt Studio

notes.title: New Keyart!
notes.content:
Dear adventurers,

We've recently [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1989720?emclan=103582791471960729&emgid=517455541724776166]revealed[/url] that the game will be called Unpetrified: Echoes of Nature. With this new name we felt it was time for a reimagined key art! 

Just to refresh your memory this is where we started:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42439321/55a2013f20c5a2abc27535b9b8412770948bbcc9.jpg[/img]

As we looked back at our original key art, we realized there were a few key elements we wanted to bring forward more clearly this time around. First and foremost, we wanted more vibrant colors to really capture the game's aesthetic. 

We also wanted to make sure that the Fox and Golem were front and center. Their journey really is the heart of the game, but you'll obviously still be able to meet the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1989720/view/538849539213230143/]other animals[/url] as well! 😉

You might also be able to spot some 'happy flowers'. These unique collectibles will be visible on the Golem's back once you discover them. How many will you be able to collect?

Last, but not least we wanted to give a glimpse of a new location. Without giving too much away, this place plays an important role in the story, and we’re excited for you to begin piecing together its mystery.

Without further ado, this is the version we ended up with:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42439321/461b7602cd90e1d1eec17894e1c5946c7abb2500.jpg[/img]
We can't wait to hear what you think of the updated look! 

— Dreamhunt Studio

notes.title: Cute Animals
notes.content:
[b]Meet these Adorable Animals in Unpetrified [/b]

Nature is waking up, and with it, you will meet some incredibly cute little friends! 

In Unpetrified: Echoes of Nature, it is not just about restoring a magical world, you’ll share it with an entire cast of adorable creatures who bring life to your surroundings!  😊 

[h2]Who Will You Meet? [/h2]

Playful Foxes 🦊 

Starting off with fluffy tailed creatures, these little friends love to play all day and… you’ll bond with a rather curious Fox along your journey. Leading the way for an unforgettable friendship!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42439321/227fcf920969e157da6da20950223091338dc702.gif[/img]

Sleepy Baby Bunnies 🐇 

Ssshhh… this little bunny was hopping through the field all day long! Just look at how adorable it twitches its nose. 🥹 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42439321/683de6b481afd486b0b92aae537fb8f02b54d219.gif[/img]

Happy Sand Cats 🐈 

Tiny, incredibly soft and sooo cute. What more can you ask from this playful kitty? It’s a common favourite of those who like animals for a reason! 😻 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42439321/54c11bbd7b85cf271f8fe6c5b270ae32b4d07725.gif[/img]

Scrumptious Squirrels 🐿️ 

You’ll almost always see them dashing from tree to tree with something to nibble on 🌰 their chubby cheeks are too adorable to not get distracted by!   

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42439321/57e2ecbb0f840016acd48d859726ff3e8af7b86a.gif[/img]

Jumpy Sheep 🐑 

This woolly sheep in particular does not shleep around 😉 Just look at it, hopping with joy as if something magical just happened!  

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42439321/c22d3988be60f3c9a26675e1c25c7e2a2c4c340f.gif[/img]

We hope you’re still with us after that cuteness overload. Which animal would you want to befriend first? Let us know in the comments! 💛 

[b]Don’t forget to wishlist Unpetrified: Echoes of Nature to be notified of updates from this cozy world! [/b]

notes.title: Introducing Echoes of Nature
notes.content:
Dear adventurers,

It is time for some introductions!

Unpetrified - A Dreamhunt Story has been renamed to [b]Unpetrified: Echoes of Nature[/b]. We feel that this new name really captures the essence of the game and the journey we're about to embark on. It's all about nature after all!

There is a lot of exciting new content and a teaser video being worked on, but for today the focus is on our Golem protagonist. This little comic provides a first glimpse into this mysterious character.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42439321/b5fe4aec111c74c063535b860ef3f9cd62627dbb.png[/img]
[h2][i]"Born again through magic, the Golem is deeply connected to the world around you. Its emotions are influenced by the environment in real time, shaping the weather, plants, and animals nearby."[/i][/h2]

We'd love to hear what you think about the Golem and the name change. Thank your support and stay tuned, there’s so much more to come! 💛 

— Dreamhunt Studio

notes.title: A Glimpse of the Future
notes.content:
Dear adventurers,

We’re excited to break the silence and show you a glimpse of what we've been working on!

Discover an unexpected friendship between a stone Golem and a cute Fox in Unpetrified, a singleplayer, narrative-driven adventure. The game was previously funded on [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/dreamhunt/unpetrified-a-dreamhunt-story]Kickstarter[/url] where we have been sharing posts about the development.

Below is a small preview of some ancient stone structures that house a variety of puzzle challenges. It's time to put on our thinking hat! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42439321/c2e8ed380f3ffc96959a295994118eb513d3bdf2.png[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42439321/26fc695d7272753f3b0e9e2898a24e92a320e4ec.png[/img]
🐾 Let us know what you’re most excited to see in the comments!

Thank you for your patience and support! Stay tuned, there’s so much more to come. 💛 

— Dreamhunt Studio
